proposal.description: 'Doubles each strike' misread as a shift of two per strike, so the cool-down quadruples with each strike instead of doubling
proposal.reason: At strike level 1 or higher (every hiccup, since strike_counter increments on entry), hiccup_done comes after base_clks<<(2*level) clocks instead of base_clks<<level. For example, it comes after 4*base instead of 2*base at level 1.

proposal.description: The counter and hiccup_done are re-armed when the cool-down finishes instead of when the supervisor leaves S_HICCUP
proposal.reason: hiccup_done becomes a one-clock pulse. Outside S_HICCUP the counter keeps running, so hiccup_done is raised while hiccup_active is low. A later entry into S_HICCUP starts partway through a count, so the cool-down it gets is shorter than base_clks<<strike_level and its length depends on timing.

why: make lint already catches it: make lint: UNUSEDSIGNAL
